intelligence.human_view: Think of Personal as your house, and the Hub as the house next door that is already finished. Your house has to match it — the same side rail with your people in it, the same boards under your notes, the same doors opening the same rooms. The front door is fifteen questions: who you are, what you do, what you dream of. Answer them, and the house arrives furnished — no blank rooms, no second form. If a room is not built yet, its door does not pretend: it takes you to the walk that builds it. There is one Invite button, in purple, and Connections wears a magenta you cannot mistake for it. Mail and messenger live in one room with a little switch between them. Your people stay where they belong — the friends of your Personal stay on Personal, the business people on Business. And Smart Worlds is the contents page at the front of the book: worlds, people, notes, shares, all listed in one place, so you never hunt for your own life. And the house is not shown until it is whole — because sending a half-finished house and calling it done is how you get asked, "what for?"
intelligence.simple_view: Your page is your home. Every door in it must open. No door may lead to nowhere. You answer fifteen questions. Then your whole world is made. Your friends sit in one list. Your mail and your chats live together. One Invite button invites your friends. Each button wears its own colour.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — your page should be just like the Hub, dear, the very same side rail with your people in it, the very same boards under your notes, every door opening where it ought to! Fifteen little questions, love, and your whole world arrives made — no blank rooms, no forms to fill twice! One Invite button, dear, in purple, and Connections in a magenta you can't mistake for it! Mail and messenger live together in one room, love, with a little switch to go back and forth! And your people stay where they belong, dear — your Personal friends on Personal, your business people on Business, just as they are! Smart Worlds is the contents page at the front, love — worlds, people, notes, shares, all listed in one place!
intelligence.naya_view: Walkthrough: fifteen max per world — ten About frames + five core Skills; same fifteen offered for Business and World; skip anything; uncreated door goes straight into its walkthrough; plus button opens a walkthrough for another world (what is it, motto, vision) that creates the page. The ten-question draft walk is replaced — do not build or cite it. The captain's four adds (pre-fill, adaptive questions, live build, match at creation) are proposals, not law — they await his word. Rail: the Hub's DM rail onto Personal, byte for byte from the Hub fix tip, auto-organizing by the feed, most recent and most relevant first. Boards: the Hub's current board set, full layer set + Naya Note flip, harvested byte for byte; Why It Matters and How It Connects render empty and honest until the schema DDL lands on his tap — never invented; flip creator-only. Doors: About and Skills land on About and Skills, or name what is missing and open the walkthrough; no dead links anywhere. Invite: one door, labelled "Invite" — rename Smart Inviter to "Invite" (same href, joinus.nayanet.app), remove the other Invite button (growthbtn), fold the email section into the one door or remove it; verify first-hand the Growth room is still reached from somewhere and report where. Colours: Connections = very evident magenta from the settled palette, never invented; Invite keeps purple #8e24aa; resolve the whole row so no two buttons clash; check by eye — if two buttons look the same colour, they are the same colour. Sidebars: aligned, one set, same on every page; right sidebar opens on tap, proven from his seat, phone first. Mail door: mail + instant messenger, one interface, toggle mail view ↔ messenger view. Connections stay put — personal, business, world, each on its own page; no migration, no merging. Smart Worlds: table of contents for all Smart Lists — Worlds (joined / created by you / yours / connected to), Connections (any grouping), Smart Notes (collections), Your Notes, Posts You Shared; record the structure in the frame registry. Never send a page link as done while any part of it still differs from the Hub.
